```plato

    //==
    // # Sampled grid field evaluation
    //
    // The `Eval` bodies for the node-sampled fields of `sampling.types.plato`.
    // Values are stored one per grid NODE, so a grid of n cells along an axis has
    // n + 1 samples on it, read through IIndexable2D's ColumnCount / RowCount. Those
    // bound to a `Row(0).Count` workaround until plato-378 gave Array2D/Array3D an
    // honest layout whose extent FIELDS discharge the obligations.
    //
    // Evaluation is multilinear between the surrounding nodes, and outside the
    // bounds it clamps to the edge — the behaviour the file header states, and the
    // only one that keeps the field total. The clamp happens on the integer node
    // index, not on the position, so a query far outside costs the same as one just
    // outside.
    //
    // The scalar, vector and color families differ only in what is being blended;
    // each type carries its own body because the value type changes, and this
    // vocabulary has no way to write "the multilinear blend of anything
    // IInterpolatable stored in an Array2D".

    //==
    // # Node lookup helpers

    // An index clamped into [0, count - 1]; the edge-clamp of the sampling rule.
    ClampIndex(i: Integer, count: Integer): Integer
        => i.Max(0).Min(count - 1);
```
